readings: Using only fee records whose fee rate (`feerate`) is strictly greater than 0.0009, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and order side (`dealedge`), compute the average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`, ignoring missing values) and the number of fee records in the group. Then compute each side's average of those group averages. List the groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than their side's average. Show `orderslink`, side, the group's average net fee rate, its record count, and the group average minus the side average. Sort by that difference from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round anything.

Using only fee records whose fee rate (`feerate`) is greater than or equal to 0.0009, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and order side (`dealedge`), compute the average net fee rate (`feerate` minus `rebrate`, ignoring missing values) and the number of fee records in the group. Then compute each side's average of those group averages. List the groups whose average net fee rate is strictly greater than their side's average. Show `orderslink`, side, the group's average net fee rate, its record count, and the group average minus the side average. Sort by that difference from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round anything.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         o.dealedge AS side,
         AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
s AS (
  SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_net) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg
  FROM g
)
SELECT orderslink, side, avg_net AS avg_net_fee_rate, cnt AS record_count, avg_net - side_avg AS diff
FROM s
WHERE avg_net > side_avg
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
